dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Progressive isolated cerebellar degeneration causing sporadic adult-onset cerebellar ataxia (SAOA), with no identifiable cause established

ALTERNATIVE 1: Genetic spinocerebellar ataxia, particularly SCA6 due to a CACNA1A CAG-repeat expansion

ALTERNATIVE 2: Autoimmune cerebellar ataxia, including anti-GAD65 or paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration

ALTERNATIVE 3: Multiple-system atrophy, cerebellar type (MSA-C)
